comments.overrides: Force patched versions of transitive build/dev-only deps flagged by Dependabot. None ship in the extension bundle (all pulled by wxt/vite/web-ext-run tooling). shell-quote: quadratic-DoS in parse(), fixed 1.9.0 (1.8.4 was still vulnerable); tmp: arbitrary write; uuid: advisory; esbuild: dev-server request advisory; adm-zip: DoS via crafted zip (firefox-profile, used by wxt's Firefox dev runner); brace-expansion: pinned per minimatch major. DO NOT 'fix' THE REMAINING brace-expansion ADVISORY (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg) BY RAISING THESE PINS — it is not fixable here and the attempt breaks the toolchain SILENTLY. The advisory is patched only in brace-expansion 5.0.8, and 5.x changed the export shape: minimatch@3.x does `require('brace-expansion')` and gets 'expand is not a function', minimatch@9.x uses a default import and gets '(0, brace_expansion_1.default) is not a function'. Both throw at RUNTIME while `npm audit` cheerfully reports 0 vulnerabilities, so the breakage does not show up in CI. Only minimatch@10 can consume 5.x. All affected copies are dev-only and never bundled: minimatch@3.1.5 via wxt -> web-ext-run -> multimatch@6 (Firefox dev runner), minimatch@9.0.9 via @vue/test-utils -> js-beautify -> {glob@10, editorconfig}. Nested/scoped overrides aimed at those subtrees do not take effect. The real fix has to come from upstream dropping those deps; re-check when @vue/test-utils stops depending on js-beautify or web-ext-run stops using multimatch@6.
